candidate.answerReason: Perimeters have the same ratio as corresponding sides, so the larger perimeter is 12 × 5/3 = 20 cm.

methods.label: Use the perimeter ratio
methods.explanation: The perimeter ratio equals the similarity ratio: \(12/x=3/5\), so \(x=20\).
methods.levelReason: Perimeter scaling is a standard Grade 9 property of similar triangles.
